title: 第17章 不可思议的突破第18章 天玄境
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 听到莫阳的话，太上长老显然不相信。
因为在大陆上，丹药自成一脉，几乎是被垄断的。
别说莫阳，就算是整个灵虚宗一年也才会去采购一次丹药。
而且因为丹药售卖的价格极高，每次采购的数量也不会超过三十枚。
关键是他们所能买到的丹药都是一些普通的丹药。
而莫阳刚才所说的两种丹药皆非凡品，驻颜丹他们不了解，但洗髓丹他们都知道，那是一种洗练根骨的宝丹，而且有价无市，连那些大宗门都会争抢。
别说无法购买，就算能买到，莫阳也根本没有能力去购买，单是那天价就不是一个弟子所能承受得起的。
莫阳冷哼了一声，道：“真相到底如何，等苏菲儿醒了，你们可以自己去问她事情始末，至于丹药的事情，我凭什么要告诉你！”
大长老脸色被气得铁青，他刚想开口，莫阳屋中忽然传出一股波动，将他到嘴边的话硬生生堵了回去。
“难道菲儿突破了！”太上长老忍不住惊呼，那波动分明是修为突破时所产生的。
而且紧随其后一股通灵境三阶的气息从屋中传荡出来。
连宗主眼中都露出一丝欣喜，苏菲儿的修为他再清楚不过，如今达到通灵境三阶，显然是突破了。
不过还未等众人开口说什么，一群长老的脸色渐渐凝固了。
因为那传荡出来的气息发生了变化，通灵境三阶初期渐渐的朝着中期转变，气息越来越强盛。
“这是……发生了什么，这……修为怎么可能这样增长……”二长老脸上神色惊疑不定的，他盯着莫阳身后的屋子，说话都结巴起来。
莫阳虽然也有些意外，但并不吃惊。
苏菲儿一次性服用了那么多洗髓丹，虽然差点丢了性命，但好处也是难以想象的，经过如此彻底的洗精伐髓，好比脱胎换骨，潜能被释放，修为突破也在情理之中。
“通灵境三阶中期了，这……”宗主也忍不住惊呼起来。
他修炼这么多年，还是第一次见到修为能这样增长的。
而且那股气息还在缓缓变强，直至临近三阶巅峰，一切才彻底停下来。
太上长老实在忍不住，刷的朝屋内冲去，冲到房门口才蓦然停住，回头朝莫阳问道：“小子，菲儿衣裙都穿上了没？”
跟着朝屋内冲去的宗主也是一个趔趄，急忙停住脚步，回头朝莫阳看去。
其他几位长老也同样如此，目光全都看向莫阳，如今也顾不上追究那丹药的话题了。
他整张脸瞬间黑成了锅贴，这锅看来背定了，怎么解释都解释不通。
他之前说了那么多，好像都是在对牛弹琴。
感受着那一道道询问的目光，莫阳斩钉截铁的开口道：“我没脱！”
“我再说一遍，我什么都没做，肉没吃，汤没喝，也没煮饭！”
太上长老愣了愣，开口道：“不开窍的小子，等稍后再和你算账！”
content_en:
After hearing Mo Yang's words, the Supreme Elder obviously didn't believe it.
Because on the mainland, elixirs are a genre of their own and are almost monopolized.
Not to mention Mo Yang, even the entire Lingxu Sect only purchases elixirs once a year.
And because the elixirs are sold at extremely high prices, the quantity purchased each time will not exceed thirty.
The key is that the elixirs they can buy are all ordinary elixirs.
The two elixirs Mo Yang mentioned just now are both extraordinary. They don't understand the Zhuyan Dan, but they all know the Marrow Cleansing Dan. It is a treasure elixir that can cleanse the roots and bones, and it is so expensive that even the big sects will fight for it.
Not to mention that it was impossible to buy it, even if it could be bought, Mo Yang would not be able to buy it at all. The price alone was not something that a disciple could afford.
Mo Yang snorted coldly and said: "What is the truth? When Sophie wakes up, you can ask her the whole story yourself. As for the pill, why should I tell you!"
The great elder's face was livid with anger. Just as he was about to speak, a wave of waves suddenly came from Mo Yang's room, and the words that came to his mouth were blocked.
"Did Feier have a breakthrough!" The Supreme Elder couldn't help but exclaim. The fluctuation was clearly caused by the breakthrough in cultivation.
And immediately afterwards, a breath of third-level psychic realm came out of the house.
Even the sect master showed a hint of joy in his eyes. He knew Sophie's cultivation very well. Now that she had reached the third level of the psychic realm, she had obviously made a breakthrough.
But before anyone could say anything, the faces of a group of elders gradually solidified.
Because the aura coming out has changed, the early stage of the third level of the psychic realm gradually changes to the middle stage, and the aura becomes stronger and stronger.
"What... happened? How could this... cultivation level increase like this..." The second elder had a look of surprise on his face. He stared at the room behind Mo Yang and stuttered while speaking.
Although Mo Yang was a little surprised, he was not surprised.
Sophie took so many marrow cleansing pills at one time. Although she almost lost her life, the benefits were unimaginable. After such a thorough cleansing and marrow cleansing, it was like being reborn, her potential was released, and her cultivation breakthrough was also reasonable.
"It's the middle stage of the third level of the psychic realm, this..." The sect master couldn't help but exclaimed.
After so many years of cultivation, this is the first time he has seen such an increase in cultivation.
And that aura was still slowly getting stronger, and it wasn't until it was approaching the peak of the third level that everything stopped completely.
The Supreme Elder couldn't bear it anymore and rushed into the house. He rushed to the door of the room before suddenly stopping. He turned back and asked Mo Yang: "Boy, have you put on all your clothes?"
The sect leader who rushed towards the house also staggered, stopped hurriedly, and looked back at Mo Yang.
The other elders did the same, all looking at Mo Yang, and now they couldn't care less about pursuing the topic of the elixir.
Mo Yang: "..."
His whole face instantly turned black into pot stickers. It seemed that he was determined to bear the blame. No matter how he explained it, he couldn't explain it.
He said so much before, it seemed like he was talking to a cow.
Feeling the questioning eyes, Mo Yang said decisively: "I'm not taking off my clothes!"
"I'll say it again, I didn't do anything, I didn't eat the meat, I didn't drink the soup, I didn't cook the rice!"
The Supreme Elder was stunned for a moment, then said: "I'll settle the score with you later, you ignorant boy!"
